corrections.original: FACT: ADMP guideline section 6.1 treats ADMP as a qualitative DPIA trigger regardless of intended extent. Section 1.3 calls for earliest-stage DPO engagement. Section 10.2.6 says AI must not be the sole factor, but it sits under 10.2's formulation that the controller may adopt the following best practices. Do not flatten this wording into a separately enforced statutory AI ban.
corrections.corrected: FACT: Section 6.1 broadly treats ADMP as a qualitative DPIA trigger regardless of intended extent, but section 7.1 says the guideline may not apply to all ADMP and identifies a legal/significant-effects applicability threshold. Section 10.1 applies where AI is used for ADMP. Obtain an authorised determination of how sections 6.1/7.1/10.1 apply to the selected workflow; neither universal coverage nor cancellation of every section 6.1 duty follows. Section 1.3 calls for earliest-stage DPO engagement. Section 10.2.6 remains inside section 10.2's may-adopt best-practices formulation, not a separately established statutory AI ban.
